local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the 6 test classes (plus the RecordingThreadContextMap fixture), the generated library metadata (5 reflection, 4 resource entries) and the test-only split (3 reflection entries). All metadata is agent-generated and conditioned on log4j-api classes: the LoggerContextFactory named by log4j2.loggerContextFactory, the default ParameterizedMessageFactory, ThreadDumpMessage's ThreadInfo probe, String serialization inside ObjectMessage, and the provider, component, status and simplelog property resources. The test build sets log4j2.loggerContextFactory and log4j2.threadContextMap as system properties for both the JVM and native test runs, because LogManager and ThreadContext read them once in static initializers. Dynamic access coverage is 11/21 per the library stats (11/17 in the GraalVM 25 report). The uncovered LogManager and ThreadContext provider branches are mutually exclusive with the property branches in one process. All three native lanes (GraalVM 25, latest, latest future-defaults-all), checkstyle and spotlessCheck pass. Dropped scenarios: LocalizedMessage serialization, because writeObject needs a bundle base name and the agent's conditional merge records that ResourceBundle lookup as an unconditional entry naming the test bundle, which would leak a test type into shipped metadata; LocalizedMessage formatting from a ListResourceBundle instance, because Native Image requires bundle contents registered at build time and the agent records no lookup for an instance bundle; ThreadDumpMessage thread listings, because Native Image's ThreadMXBean returns no thread infos. The two ObjectMessage round trips share one test so the String serialization registration survives the agent's conditional merge.

metadata_rules: when `org.apache.logging.log4j.message.ObjectMessage` is reached, make `java.lang.String` available for reflection
when `org.apache.logging.log4j.message.ThreadDumpMessage` is reached, make `java.lang.management.ThreadInfo` available for reflection
when `org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.AbstractLogger` is reached, make `org.apache.logging.log4j.message.ParameterizedMessageFactory.<init>()` available for reflection
when `org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager` is reached, make `org.apache.logging.log4j.simple.SimpleLoggerContextFactory.<init>()` available for reflection
when `org.apache.logging.log4j.message.ThreadDumpMessage$ExtendedThreadInfoFactory` is reached, make `sun.management.VMManagementImpl` available for reflection
